ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark-grey field with localized high-intensity white clusters. Macro-level ratio of dark-to-light pixels is approximately 9:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-grey surface background with distinct, high-contrast light-grey circular ring clusters located in the mid-to-lateral right lobe and lower-left lobe. High-intensity white clusters are localized at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch at center; calculated angle approximately 52 degrees with a vertical depth of approximately 100 pixels relative to adjacent lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Non-uniform serration with high-amplitude peaks on the lateral third of the right lobe. The left lobe exhibits more uniform, medium-frequency serration along the medial and lateral margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep of the trailing edge originating from the median notch and extending toward the pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of roughly 12 circular high-contrast light-grey ring patterns (5-15 pixel diameter) concentrated on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of sparse, unaligned light-grey linear disruptions on the medial surface of both lobes, primarily oriented vertically.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Live sessile barnacles (high-intensity white clusters) attached to the distal tips and trailing edges. Widespread circular depigmented scarring from past barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced barnacle clustering at the distal peaks, creating a secondary jagged topography on the fluke tips.
